channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: What happened when Border Patrol agents showed up at Minneapolis’ Roosevelt High School
item.description: The confrontation occurred a few miles and just hours after the fatal shooting of Renee Good by an ICE agent.

item.title: Takeaways: Timberwolves defense disappears and so does winning streak in 144-132 loss to Cavaliers
item.description: Cleveland avenged its loss from Thursday by running away with a 47-point fourth quarter.

item.title: Takeaways: Wild give up three leads, lose to Islanders in OT in return from road trip
item.description: Ben Jones scored his first NHL goal, and Kirill Kaprizov moved into second place in team’s all-time scoring, but it wasn’t enough.

item.title: Thousands protest as more immigration agents head to Minnesota
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security says “the evidence speaks for itself” as the agency shares a new video of the minutes before Renee Good’s shooting.

item.title: Souhan: Who should be the Vikings’ next QB? Look beyond the names you’re hearing.
item.description: One veteran player hasn’t come up much in connection to the Vikings, but would fit their QB room perfectly.

item.title: What ICE agents can and can’t do — and what legal rights the public has during encounters
item.description: Our FAQ on warrants, masks and what legal observers can document.

item.title: Inspectors found dead rodents at Minneapolis food distributor years before big recall
item.description: Inspectors listed a leaking roof in a 2018 inspection at Gold Star Distribution. Water dripped from the roof toward merchandise during a reporter’s tour last week.

item.title: City: 30 arrests, some damage caused during raucous ICE protest in downtown Minneapolis
item.description: Protesters were staged outside a hotel where ICE agents are believed to be staying and made noise for hours.

item.title: In Minnesota’s most conservative county, GOP governor hopefuls weigh in on ICE shooting, Walz
item.description: Ten Republican candidates set the table for this year’s election with a focus on fraud.

item.title: Breaking down the videos: A close examination of the shooting of Renee Good
item.description: In just seconds, an encounter with ICE agents turned deadly. The Star Tribune examined the video evidence frame by frame.
